cohort: 2178 women with singleton breech presentation at term
finding: In singleton-term breech presentations, emergency cesarean section was not associated with an increase in serious maternal and neonatal morbidity compared to elective cesarean section in a tertiary care setting.
mod_finding: Women with singleton-term breech presentation who underwent emergency cesarean section did not experience an increase in serious maternal and neonatal morbidity compared with those who underwent elective cesarean section.
